reasoning_content: curl can't resolve *.localhost? Actually .localhost should resolve to 127.0.0.1. But exit code 6 = couldn't resolve host. The `*.localhost` TLD is handled by browsers/OS resolvers, but the C library resolver may not. Let me test with --resolve or check. The proxy port may be 80. Let me check the urbo-proxy port and test via direct IP.

action.command: getent hosts api.workspace.localhost; echo "getent exit=$?"; cat /etc/hosts; echo "=== proxy port ==="; docker port urbo-proxy; echo "=== direct localhost ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "127.0.0.1 => %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1/health; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "127.0.0.1/ => %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1/
